adjudication.demonstrates: Distinct example for contract-030: the realistic repeated-reference hazard is a recurring direct debit whose narrative carries the customer ACCOUNT number every month, so consecutive invoices share the payment reference. The compiler blocks on the repeated reference even though the July invoice is already settled and the August debit lands on the August due date; the disambiguation is by date and prior settlement, which the contract cannot yet express.
